x: Rutland, a fast and fair walker, with several years of his 'teens still to run, was second, not for the first time this season. E.
Storey maintained his recent good form and won easily, Heather was second and Charlie Speechley third. The 1 Mile Club Handicap was won by a comparative newcomer in E.
Included in the meeting were also three Club running handicaps. The 880 Yards was won by Alec Ball, with E.
The South of Thames "Junior" team race was held at Epsom Downs on November 9th, the weather being ideal for running, and we looked forward to a good race. E.
On April 25th also, another young friend, E.
Tony Stone finished 4th in the M50's in 18:11.4. Barbara Dunsford threw 18.72 for 2nd in the W55 Hammer behind Evaun Williams who broke the World record with a throw of 37.90.
